requested_launch: one GNOME Terminal launch with one startup acknowledgement and no polling

findings.detail: The reusable campaign runner consumes the prior real_input_windows.pt, which contains development_E41 samples, and its expanded-data builder promotes E41 into training. This violates the new round's mandatory E41 exclusion.

The reusable model condition path consumes RGB vision tokens and normalized absolute ABC state. Masking them consistently in training and online inference, while retaining two-frame relative OCT xyz/valid, velocity, previous accepted ABC, and the original DiT/RF action path, is not implemented in this task-local runner.
The task-local collector is configured for the prior E40-E42 campaign, including E41. It cannot be used unchanged for an E40/E42-only collection or a separately registered third training target.

Existing E40/E41 paired 50um trajectories and hold evidence remain available read-only in prior run directories; the prior campaign also retains checkpoint and four near trajectories. No diagnostic was allowed to relax the new training/data-isolation requirements.

reason: Starting the copied runner would train on E41 and use absolute RGB/ABC inputs, so it would not execute the authorized hypothesis. No GNOME launch was issued.
